PlayerProgress.title: PlayerProgress
PlayerProgress.description: Persisted unlocked endings and player name for AMORA across sessions.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

playerName.description: Hero name chosen by the player.

unlockedEndings.description: Unique unlocked ending identifiers (ALL_FIGHT, ALL_SPARE, MIXED, SECRET_PIRATE).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last progress update.

/userProgress/{userId}.description: Stores each player's unlocked AMORA endings so progress persists across sessions.
